sentences.ar: ركضت لحد ما ما عدت أسمع صوتهم.
sentences.en: I ran until I could no longer hear their voices.

sentences.ar: ووقفت بغابة، ولأول مرة بحياتي، كنت لحالي بمكان جديد.
sentences.en: And I stopped in a wood, and for the first time in my life, I was alone in a new place.

sentences.ar: شجر ما بعرفه، وطيور ما بعرفها، وحية زغيرة رفعت راسها.
sentences.en: Trees I did not know, birds I did not know, and a small snake raised its head.

sentences.ar: وبعدين وصلت على مستنقع، ومن ورا الشجر، سمعت أصوات.
sentences.en: And then I reached a marsh, and from beyond the trees, I heard voices.

sentences.ar: صوت سيلفر، وصوت تاني، لبحار اسمه توم.
sentences.en: Silver's voice, and another, of a sailor named Tom.
I crawled closer, and hid behind a tree.
Silver was speaking in his warm voice.

sentences.ar: يا توم، إنت زلمة منيح، وأنا بحبك.
sentences.en: Tom, you are a good man, and I like you.
Come with us.
All the rest are with us.

sentences.ar: قال توم: يا جون، أنا بحبك كمان، بس أنا مش خاين.
sentences.en: Tom said: John, I like you too, but I am no traitor.

sentences.ar: أنا بموت قبل ما أخون الكابتن.
sentences.en: I die before I betray the captain.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، من بعيد، سمعنا صرخة.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, from afar, we heard a scream.

sentences.ar: صرخة واحدة، طويلة، وبعدين ولا إشي.
sentences.en: One scream, long, and then nothing.
Tom said: what was that?
Silver said calmly: that?
That is Alan, I suppose.

sentences.ar: آلان كان بحار تاني، رفض ينضم لهم.
sentences.en: Alan was another sailor, who had refused to join them.
Tom understood.
He said: Alan!
God rest him.

sentences.ar: وإنت، يا جون سيلفر، إنت شيطان.
sentences.en: And you, John Silver, you are a devil.
Kill me if you can.
I am going.
And he turned his back and walked away.

sentences.ar: سيلفر مسك عكازه، ورماه بكل قوته.
sentences.en: Silver seized his crutch, and threw it with all his strength.
It struck Tom in the back, and he fell.

sentences.ar: وسيلفر نط عليه على إجر وحدة، زي القرد، وطعنه مرتين.
sentences.en: And Silver leapt on him on one leg, like a monkey, and stabbed him twice.
I do not know how I did not scream.

sentences.ar: الدنيا لفت حواليّ، والشجر صار يدور.
sentences.en: The world spun around me, and the trees began to turn.

sentences.ar: ولما رجعت أشوف، كان سيلفر واقف، بيمسح سكينته على العشب.
sentences.en: And when I could see again, Silver was standing, wiping his knife on the grass.

sentences.ar: وبعدين صفر بصفارة، وعرفت إنه بينادي الباقي.
sentences.en: And then he blew a whistle, and I knew he was calling the others.
I ran.
I ran without knowing where.

sentences.ar: وكل ما أركض، أفكر: أنا ميت.
sentences.en: And as I ran I thought: I am dead.
Silver knows I heard.

sentences.ar: وفجأة، وقف قدامي إشي من ورا شجرة.
sentences.en: And suddenly, something stepped in front of me from behind a tree.
Not a man and not an animal.
Something moving fast, and vanishing.
